Coram : S.H. KAPADIA*, SWATANTER KUMAR
Rajasthan Sales Tax Act, 1994 - s. 78(2) and (5) - Issue as regard imposition of penalty in terms of s. 78(5) on account C of not giving material particulars in form ST 18 A - Penalty set aside by appellate authority as also Tax Board - Revision petition - Dismissed by High Court - On appeal, held: Records and facts clearly show that High Court erred in law in not recording any reasons - D Thus, order of High Court is unreasoned and suffers from the infirmity of non-application of mind - Order of High Court set aside and the case remitted back to High Court. Certain
Decision Date : 15-04-2010 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3288/2010 | Disposal Nature : Case Partly allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
